description: A continuous value between min and max (DESIGN.md, Slider): TsuyaSize.target tall; a TsuyaSpace.s4 track in TsuyaColors.track, filled with the accent from the start (from the end under right-to-left); a 20 thumb in TsuyaColors.thumb with TsuyaShadows.sm and a hairline ring, the focus ring around it. Arrow keys move by step (a twentieth of the range by default), Page Up/Down by a tenth (at least one step), Home/End to the ends. The value is announced as a percentage unless valueLabel formats it.

constructors.description: A slider at value, named label.

params.name: value
params.description: The current value, between min and max.

params.name: onChanged
params.description: Called with the next value as it is dragged or pressed; null disables it.

params.name: onChangeEnd
params.description: Called once with the final value when a drag or a key press ends.

params.name: step
params.description: The amount arrow keys move by, and dragging snaps to; a twentieth of the range when null.

params.name: valueLabel
params.description: Formats the announced value; a percentage of the range by default.

params.name: focusNode
params.description: The node to track focus with, when the caller manages one.

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Focuses it as soon as it is built.
